services.desc: Our private event package begins at $2,500 for 7 hours of exclusive farm use, with flexible options to tailor the experience to your vision. We also offer hourly rates for more intimate gatherings in a smaller setting. Tell us a little about what you’re planning, and we’ll send the full package details straight to your inbox. As we host a limited number of events each year, we recommend reaching out early to reserve your preferred date. For birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, corporate events, rehearsal dinners, or other small events, please fill out this form.
